text: Nde on daɗuɗo hewtunoo ka Yuusufa, o wi'ani mo: Ko an yo Yuusufa, an goonguɗo! Humpitii men firo hoyɗuɗo na'i jeeɗiɗi fayɗi na nyaama fooƴuɗi jeeɗiɗi ɗin. O yi'ii kadi butaali jeeɗiɗi kecci e yooruɗe jeeɗiɗi. Belajo'o, ɓe ruttoto ka laamɗo on e yimɓe makko ɓen, belajo'o, ɓe annda firo koyɗol laamɗo on, ɓe annda kadi ɓural maa ngal e darja maa on.
